title: Striking the Credit for Rider Premium Charged Before Cover Began
content:
Rider premium charged on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders for a coverage month beginning before the day the rider took effect is owed back to the member, and is relieved by a credit against the single rider premium charge that carried it.

## 1. The charge put right

The charge put right is the rider premium charge carrying the most money of any standing on the rider premium account.

## 2. The coverage months one charge carries

The coverage months one rider premium charge carries are the single coverage month it is booked to.

## 3. The rate each coverage month is credited at

The rate each coverage month is credited at is the amount of the charge being put right.

## 4. The coverage months charged before cover began

The coverage months charged before cover began are the whole calendar months from the day the rider took effect to the day benefits became payable.

## 5. The credit before any ceiling

The credit before any ceiling is the rate each coverage month is credited at multiplied by the coverage months charged before cover began, rounded to the nearest cent.

## 6. The ceiling

The ceiling on the credit is the amount of the charge being put right less the credits already posted to the rider premium account, and is never less than nothing.

## 7. The credit posted

The credit posted is the lesser of the credit before any ceiling and that ceiling, rounded to the nearest cent, and a credit never exceeds the charge it relieves.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

A rider premium account carries charges of 28.60 USD, 28.60 USD and 57.20 USD, and credits already posted coming to 10.00 USD. The rider took effect at the start of one month and benefits became payable six whole calendar months later.

1. The charge put right is the largest standing on the account, 57.20 USD.
2. It carries the single coverage month it is booked to: 1 coverage month.
3. The rate each coverage month is credited at is the amount of that charge, 57.20 USD.
4. The coverage months charged before cover began are the whole calendar months from the day the rider took effect to the day benefits became payable: 6.
5. The credit before any ceiling is 57.20 USD multiplied by 6, that is 343.20 USD.
6. The ceiling is 57.20 USD less the 10.00 USD already credited, that is 47.20 USD.
7. The credit posted is the lesser of 343.20 USD and 47.20 USD, that is **47.20 USD** — which does not exceed the charge it relieves.

Every figure above is a hypothetical input.
